subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: What is the most significant constraint a public procurement negotiator faces that private sector corporate negotiators generally do not face?
options: The inability to use Microsoft Excel for cost modeling
Strict adherence to statutory procedures, transparency laws, and open public records requirements
A complete ban on buying foreign goods
The inability to use contracts lasting more than 6 months
questions.explain: Public sector negotiators operate in a heavily regulated environment. They cannot use 'back room deals' because their negotiations, concessions, and final documents are subject to public records laws and scrutiny.
